questions.stem: The average age of a group of 5 boys is exactly 12 years. What is the total sum of their ages?
questions.explanation: Average = Sum of ages / Number of boys. Therefore, Sum of ages = Average × Number of boys = 12 × 5 = 60 years.

questions.stem: The average age of A and B is 20 years. If C were to replace A, the average age would drop to 19. If C is exactly 18 years old, what is the exact age of A?
questions.explanation: A + B = 20 × 2 = 40. C + B = 19 × 2 = 38. Since C = 18, we have 18 + B = 38, meaning B = 20. Then A + 20 = 40, which means A = 20 years old.

questions.stem: Exactly 3 years ago, the average age of a family of 5 members was 17 years. A baby having been born, the average age of the family is the exact same today. The present age of the baby is:
questions.explanation: Sum of ages of 5 members 3 years ago = 17 × 5 = 85. Present sum of ages of these 5 members = 85 + (5 × 3) = 85 + 15 = 100. Present average of 6 members (including baby) = 17. Present sum of 6 members = 17 × 6 = 102. Therefore, baby's age = 102 - 100 = 2 years.

questions.stem: The average age of a class of 30 students is 15 years. If the teacher's age is included, the average age increases by exactly 1 year. What is the precise age of the teacher?
questions.explanation: Sum of ages of 30 students = 30 × 15 = 450. When the teacher is included, total people = 31, and new average = 15 + 1 = 16. New sum = 31 × 16 = 496. Teacher's age = 496 - 450 = 46 years.

questions.stem: The average age of 11 players on a cricket team decreases by exactly 2 months when two players aged 17 years and 20 years are replaced by two new players. What is the exact average age of the two new players?
questions.explanation: Total decrease in age for the 11 players = 11 × 2 = 22 months. The sum of the ages of the outgoing players = 17 + 20 = 37 years = 444 months. The sum of the ages of the new players = 444 - 22 = 422 months. The average age of the new players = 422 / 2 = 211 months. 211 months = 17 years (204 months) + 7 months = 17 years 7 months.

questions.stem: A father said to his son, "I was exactly as old as you are at present at the time of your birth." If the father's age is 38 years right now, what was the son's exact age five years back?
questions.explanation: Let the son's present age be x. The father's age at the time of the son's birth was (38 - x). According to the problem, (38 - x) = x. 2x = 38, so x = 19. The son's present age is 19. His age five years back was 19 - 5 = 14 years.

questions.stem: The mathematical ratio of the present ages of a mother and her daughter is exactly 7:1. Exactly four years ago, the strict ratio of their ages was 19:1. What will be the mother's precise age four years from now?
questions.explanation: Let the present ages of the mother and daughter be 7x and x respectively. Four years ago, their ages were (7x - 4) and (x - 4). So, (7x - 4) / (x - 4) = 19 / 1. 7x - 4 = 19x - 76. 12x = 72 => x = 6. The mother's present age is 7 × 6 = 42 years. Her age 4 years from now will be 42 + 4 = 46 years.
